C1577.title: Adaptive Robust Data Poisoning Detection and Purification in IoT Wearable Devices
C1577.summary: This study highlights that as wearable sensing devices become widely integrated into IoT ecosystems, machine learning-based activity recognition grows increasingly vulnerable to data poisoning attacks, where adversaries corrupt training data to manipulate AI model behavior and decisions.
